# Stress Relief Games

> Free online stress relief games you can play in your browser — pop bubble wrap, stretch slime, spin a fidget spinner, rake a zen garden, squeeze a stress ball, or cut kinetic sand. No signup, no download, no ads. Each game is a short, satisfying break designed to lower stress in under five minutes.

## Games
- [Bubble Wrap Popper](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/bubble-wrap): Pop 192 virtual bubble wrap bubbles with satisfying popping sounds. Includes Zen mode and Speed mode.
- [Slime Simulator](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/slime-simulator): Stretch, poke, and squish six types of virtual slime with realistic physics and ASMR squish sounds.
- [Zen Garden](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/zen-garden): Arrange stones, rake sand, and place plants in a relaxing Japanese-style rock garden.
- [Stress Relief Ball](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/stress-ball): Squeeze, throw, and bounce a virtual stress ball. Six ball types with realistic squish physics.
- [Fidget Spinner](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/fidget-spinner): Flick a virtual fidget spinner with realistic spin physics. Six designs, variable friction, bearing hum that rises with RPM.
- [Sand Cutting](https://stress-relief-games-production.up.railway.app/games/sand-cutting): Slice, scoop, and smooth virtual kinetic sand. Six sand colors, three tools, crisp ASMR cutting sounds.
